metadata.description: Kiln — Raw code refined into polished design. A marketplace of Claude Code plugins for design, performance, code quality, developer tooling, and learning workflows.

plugins.name: swift-design
plugins.description: Review and generate SwiftUI views for design quality, HIG compliance, accessibility, and modern API usage. 40 enforceable rules, letter grading, visual screenshot review, and design token references for iOS design excellence.

plugins.name: performance-optimization
plugins.description: Language-agnostic performance optimization skill distilled from Google's Abseil performance wisdom. Covers measurement methodology, optimization techniques, and cross-language patterns for C++, Rust, and TypeScript.

plugins.name: ui-refactor
plugins.description: UI design reviewer distilled from Refactoring UI principles. Reviews screenshots, code, and descriptions for hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, depth, and polish — with concrete CSS fixes and named anti-patterns.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Post-generation engineering quality. Codesavers removes avoidable complexity from changed code; Specsavers authors and reviews technical software specifications for precision, information density, and decision completeness.

plugins.name: teach-me
plugins.description: Tutoring-oriented Claude Code skill that prioritizes hints, guided questions, mental models, and local project context over autonomous implementation.

plugins.name: infographic
plugins.description: Generate copy-paste-ready infographic prompts from repository documentation, and call an attached image generation tool when the user explicitly asks for an actual image.

plugins.name: lottie-animation
plugins.description: Create, refine, and verify production-ready Lottie animations, including large-but-renderable JSON assets and seamless loops.

plugins.name: stacked-prs
plugins.description: Design and operate safe GitHub stacked pull request workflows with the official gh-stack CLI, from decomposition through review, merge, cleanup, and recovery.
